required_review: Resolve and pin build tooling from the exact source distribution in a separate build environment.
Verify source SHA256 before executing build scripts; do not reuse cached wheels for a different CMAKE_ARGS profile.
Keep exactly one cv2 provider and satisfy MediaPipe opencv-contrib-python metadata; do not install headless alongside it.
Inspect wheel version, license notices and complete native dependency graph, not only FFmpeg build flags.
Record source/build provenance and wheel SHA256 before installing only in a separate application test environment.
Run full tests and source/frozen diagnostics on each native platform, plus actual cameras including MJPEG USB devices.
Recheck deployment minimum and all other license obligations; do not mark MediaPipe network verification complete.
addition_rationale: Exact source CMake options reviewed: retain built-in static JPEG/PNG/zlib and AVFoundation; disable unused image formats, trace/OpenCL/LAPACK/Eigen and optional external libraries. Entire bundle minimum remains audited.
source_patch_rationale: Remap private paths in embedded build information; skip manual typing refinements only for symbols in optional modules absent from BUILD_LIST.
